# P27.8 (LAUNCH.8) — Build + deploy from the real export; public cut-over (staged)

**Spec:** `docs/tickets/P27.8__deploy-and-public-cutover.md` · **Base:** `devin/p27-7-empty-states-and-polish`
· **Stacked PR** (no merge/tag/push-main). **ADR-096.**

## Summary
Wires the national public cut-over: the deploy now builds `web/dist` from the **real national export**
(`SIG_DATA_SOURCE=export`, fail-loud — never a fixtures fall-back), partitions the licence-compartmented
bundle into a PUBLISHED tree (`exports/out/public`, public-read) and a PRIVATE tree
(`exports/out/restricted`), and **proves** no ODbL/share-alike/UNDETERMINED byte reaches a public object
before any sync (§42 / Part VIII). The HG-01/HG-11/HG-02 publication package is assembled with the
operator's carry-forward answers. The **hosted cut-over itself is honestly deferred** (D-P27.8-1): the
national export `exports/out/national` does not exist yet — it chains to the national export build
(D-P27.4-1) and the in-flight ~1.37M-claim OSM land (D-SOURCES.17-1). No live green fabricated, no
deployed URL claimed.

## What changed
- **New `ops/src/ops/publish.py`** — the public cut-over producer:
  - `assert_export_present` / `public_export_dir` / `build_public_web` — the export-mode public build
    (default `exports/out/national`; `SIG_EXPORT_DIR` overrides), **fail-loud** if the export is absent
    or the build breaks; never a fixtures fall-back for the public build (§38.1).
  - `classify_compartment` — fail-closed, data-driven off `policy/data/licenses.toml`: **public iff the
    licence is non-`share_alike` and not export-excluded**, else restricted. ODbL-1.0 + CC-BY-SA-4.0
    (share-alike), UNDETERMINED/unknown, and counsel-pending exclusions → restricted.
  - `partition_export` — copies the manifest artifacts into `exports/out/public` / `exports/out/restricted`
    with per-tier filtered manifests; returns the built-from watermark.
  - `assert_public_clean` — re-scans the public tree (manifest + physical cross-check) and raises
    `CompartmentLeak` on any share-alike/UNDETERMINED/stray artifact — the deliverable-2 proof.
  - `export_watermark` — the release/as-of/ruleset stamp the site was built from.
  - `run_public_prepare` — the network-free build → partition → assert-clean orchestration.
- **`ops/src/ops/deploy.py`** — `build_gcp_plan` gains the export-mode build (step 5) + partition (step 6)
  before the syncs; the sig-public published-only / sig-restricted private split is preserved.
- **`ops/src/ops/cli.py`** — `sig-ops deploy --prepare-only [--export-dir …]`: run the local producer
  (build + partition + prove-clean + print watermark), fail-loud; network-free; the operator runs the
  gcloud syncs afterwards.
- **`ops/cadence.toml`** — new `sig-public-national-manifest` probe target (the national published-compartment
  manifest at the public bucket root); canonical origin `https://surveillancegraph.org` documented on the
  web probe (DNS/TLS is P27.10 — the `*.run.app` fallback stays).
- **`ops/pyproject.toml`** — explicit `sig-policy` dependency (the partition reads the licence facts).
- **Gate package + records:** `PUBLICATION_CHECKLIST.md` national section; `ADR-096`; `DEFERRALS.md`
  D-P27.8-1 + LEDGER RETURN PASS row; the ticket Gate status block; the run ledger.

## Design decisions
- **ADR-096 — national cut-over publishes only the non-share-alike published compartment.** The OKC demo
  synced the whole per-jurisdiction export (incl. the ODbL layer) public, per §42.3's per-file ODbL
  publication. For the far larger national surface — with HG-11/HG-02 still owed — the ODbL/share-alike
  layers stay in the PRIVATE compartment; §42.3 governs *how* the ODbL layer is published if/when it is,
  not that it must ship in the CC-BY public bucket. Its public release is a dedicated, gated decision
  pending counsel (D-LEGAL.1-1). The rule is licence-driven (the `share_alike` flag), so it needs no new
  per-compartment field and adapts as licences are added.
- **Fail-closed everywhere.** The public build refuses to run without a real export; the classifier
  defaults unknown/UNDETERMINED licences to restricted; the leak guard cross-checks the physical tree.
